comment: Round 11's pipe fitting families (git 6eccc2969 packages/bim-kernel/src/routing/pipe/families.ts), frozen by P12 before the move. Families in full; slot choices, fit refusals and labels as SHA-256 of their stable JSON (see p12-family-matrices.ts).

families.name: 90° elbow, short radius
families.description: Standard 90° elbow.

families.name: 90° elbow, long radius
families.description: Long-radius 90°: lower loss, more take-out.

families.name: 45° elbow
families.description: Standard 45° elbow.

families.name: Tee
families.description: Straight tee; reducing when the branch is smaller than the run.

families.name: Reducer
families.description: Concentric reducing coupling between two sizes.

families.name: Cap
families.description: Closes an open end.

families.name: Coupling
families.description: Joins two lengths of the same size.

families.name: Union
families.description: Lets equipment be disconnected.

families.name: Ball valve, full port
families.description: Quarter-turn shut-off.

families.name: Gate valve
families.description: Full-open isolation valve.

families.name: Swing check valve
families.description: Stops reverse flow.

families.name: Pressure-reducing valve (placeholder)
families.description: Placeholder: its outlet set pressure isn't modelled. Enter its loss as an engineer's override from the valve's data.

families.name: 1/4 bend
families.description: Tight 90° bend. Turns horizontal flow down; vertical-to-horizontal and horizontal-to-horizontal only on small fixture drains.

families.name: 1/4 bend, short sweep
families.description: 90° sweep. Any size horizontal to vertical; vertical to horizontal from 3" up.

families.name: 1/4 bend, long sweep
families.description: Long-radius 90° sweep: the turn for the base of a stack and for horizontal-to-horizontal changes.

families.name: Closet bend
families.description: 90° bend under a water closet flange, 3" or 4".

families.name: 1/8 bend
families.description: 45° bend; any change of direction.

families.name: 1/16 bend
families.description: 22½° bend; any change of direction.

families.name: Sanitary tee
families.description: Branch sweeps down into the run. Only where horizontal flow enters a vertical stack.

families.name: Wye (45°)
families.description: Branch enters at 45° in the direction of flow.

families.name: Combination wye & 1/8 bend
families.description: A wye with a 1/8 bend on the branch: the branch leaves square, the flow joins at 45°. Any change of direction.

families.name: Vent tee
families.description: Square tee for dry vent piping; no sweep, so not for drainage.

families.name: Reducer / increaser
families.description: Changes size; drains only get larger downstream.

families.name: Test cap / plug
families.description: Closes an open end.

families.name: Cleanout (tee + plug)
families.description: Tee-pattern cleanout with a threaded plug.

families.name: Cleanout (wye + plug)
families.description: Wye-pattern cleanout for horizontal drains.

families.name: Test tee
families.description: Cleanout tee in a stack, used to plug the stack for a water test.

families.name: P-trap
families.description: Trap on a fixture's trap arm; keeps a water seal.

families.name: Coupling
families.description: Joins two lengths.

families.name: 90° elbow, threaded
families.description: Threaded 90°.

families.name: 45° elbow, threaded
families.description: Threaded 45°.

families.name: Tee, threaded
families.description: Threaded tee, straight or reducing.

families.name: Reducing coupling / bushing
families.description: Changes size.

families.name: Cap, threaded
families.description: Closes an open end.

families.name: Union, ground joint
families.description: Lets an appliance be disconnected.

families.name: Gas cock / shut-off
families.description: Appliance or zone shut-off.

families.name: Drip leg (tee + nipple + cap)
families.description: Tee on the drop to an appliance, with a capped nipple below it to catch sediment.

families.name: Gas pressure regulator
families.description: Steps the pressure down (2 psi to 11 in. w.c. at a cook line, or at one appliance); the pipe downstream is a new pressure zone sized at the outlet setting. Indoors it needs a vent limiter or a vent to outdoors.

families.name: CSST bend, 90°
families.description: CSST bends in the field; no fitting. Keep at least the manufacturer's minimum bend radius.

families.name: CSST bend, 45°
families.description: CSST field bend, 45°.

families.name: CSST tee
families.description: CSST mechanical tee.

families.name: CSST fitting
families.description: CSST mechanical fitting (coupling or termination).

families.name: PE elbow, 90°, fusion
families.description: Polyethylene gas elbow, butt or socket fusion.

families.name: PE elbow, 45°, fusion
families.description: Polyethylene gas 45°, fusion.

families.name: PE tee, fusion
families.description: Polyethylene gas tee, straight or reducing.

families.name: PE reducer, fusion
families.description: Changes PE size.

families.name: PE cap, fusion
families.description: Closes an open PE end.

families.name: Elbow
families.description: Generic pipe fitting from before the pipe library; swap it for a typed fitting.

families.name: Reducer
families.description: Generic pipe fitting from before the pipe library; swap it for a typed fitting.

families.name: Tee
families.description: Generic pipe fitting from before the pipe library; swap it for a typed fitting.

families.name: Combination wye
families.description: Generic pipe fitting from before the pipe library; swap it for a typed fitting.

families.name: Cap
families.description: Generic pipe fitting from before the pipe library; swap it for a typed fitting.
